authority: PRE-SELECTION ARCHITECTURE PLANNING EVIDENCE ONLY — DOES NOT SELECT OR ACCEPT ARCHITECTURE

questions.title: Architecture Drivers, Quality Attributes, Workload Assumptions & Trust Boundaries
questions.scope: Establish the current architecture drivers, quality priorities, live-event workload assumptions, trust boundaries, availability/recovery expectations, operational constraints and evidence thresholds that every later architecture choice must use.

questions.title: Application Ownership, Decomposition & Dependency Topology
alternative_classes: ownership-preserving modular monolith
ownership-preserving simpler monolith/package topology
selectively distributed services where boundary evidence justifies operational cost
questions.scope: Decide how semantic ownership maps to application boundaries, coordination boundaries and deployment-evolution seams without copying the historical module map.

questions.title: Authoritative Persistence, History, Provenance & Projection Architecture
alternative_classes: relational authority store with explicit history/projection separation
provider-neutral relational or hybrid persistence with owner-scoped storage
event/log-oriented or hybrid history model only if current/history and query obligations justify it
questions.scope: Decide durable authority storage, current/history representation, Provenance, correction lineage, projection/read-model strategy and migration/recovery posture.
scenario_seeds: affected Outcome Declaration with same visible winner

questions.title: Identity, Authentication, Participation, Access & Session Architecture
alternative_classes: external identity provider plus first-party application session and current Access evaluation
provider-neutral OIDC/SAML compatible identity with server-controlled session boundary
managed authentication/session alternative preserving MUDAC-owned Identity Participation and Access
questions.scope: Decide principal authentication, provider linkage, application session, reverification, compromised-device response and current Access enforcement without transferring Competition authority to the provider.

questions.title: Application Interface, Command/Query, Transaction, Concurrency, Retry & Idempotency Architecture
alternative_classes: versioned request/response command-query interface with optimistic concurrency and durable idempotency
resource-oriented interface with explicit revision/current-state preconditions and reconciliation
mixed synchronous/asynchronous command handling where high-consequence uncertainty and workload justify it
questions.scope: Decide application interface contracts and authoritative transaction/concurrency semantics, including stale intent, lost responses, retries, idempotency, partial results and unknown outcomes.
scenario_seeds: lost-response retry after consequential authoritative action

questions.title: Offline Draft, Multi-device, Degraded & Paper Recovery Architecture
alternative_classes: bounded local Draft persistence with revision-aware reconciliation
minimal offline digital continuity with server-authoritative reconnection and paper fallback
richer local-first Draft synchronization only where conflict semantics remain safely bounded
questions.scope: Decide how non-authoritative local work survives disconnects, multiple devices, context changes and paper continuity while converging to one logical evaluation.

questions.title: Artifact, Export, Publication & External Delivery Architecture
alternative_classes: immutable generated artifact store with authoritative relational metadata and explicit Publication
on-demand generation plus retained authoritative release records
hybrid retained-artifact model based on representation purpose and historical fidelity needs
questions.scope: Decide binary/artifact storage, generation, validation, Publication, delivery and stale-copy/withdrawal behavior while preserving source authority and currentness.
scenario_seeds: withdrawn Publication while external copies remain

questions.title: Browser/Client State, Navigation, Accessibility & Degraded Interaction Architecture
alternative_classes: SPA/client-rich browser architecture with explicit server-authority and cache boundaries
server-rendered or progressively enhanced browser architecture with bounded client state
hybrid browser architecture selected by live-event interaction and offline continuity needs
questions.scope: Decide browser application composition, remote/local state partition, navigation/context isolation, responsive behavior and accessibility/degraded architecture using current Phase-013 Experience authority.

questions.title: Runtime Platform, Deployment, Availability, Observability & Disaster-Recovery Architecture
alternative_classes: historical AWS managed-container/data-service architecture
alternative managed cloud/container or serverless architecture preserving authority/recovery requirements
simpler managed runtime topology if event scale and recovery evidence show lower complexity is sufficient
questions.scope: Decide deployment/runtime platform, network/trust placement, availability strategy, worker/asynchronous runtime, observability, backup/restore and regional recovery with cost and operational evidence.
scenario_seeds: lost-response retry after consequential authoritative action
deferrals: production capacity numbers until workload evidence exists
jurisdiction-specific data residency if not yet established

questions.title: Whole-Architecture Integration, Security, Failure, Performance, Cost & Reversibility Reconciliation
questions.scope: Reconcile the selected decision set as one architecture, replay semantic/failure scenarios, inspect cross-owner coupling and derived-authority leakage, assess security/accessibility/recovery/performance/cost/reversibility, and determine whether accepted current architecture authority may be created.
scenario_seeds: lost-response retry after consequential authoritative action
affected Outcome Declaration with same visible winner
withdrawn Publication while external copies remain
